## The changing balance {#fm3-finish .fm-slide }

Simple interest adds the **same amount** each period.

Compound interest multiplies the current balance by the **same factor** each period.

::: {.takeaway}
I can calculate compound growth over three periods and explain how it differs from simple interest.
:::

<p class="small-note">No new homework set at this point. Continue the existing simple-interest practice.</p>
